headline: Zhipu AI surges; three models debut in top 50
summary: Zhipu AI jumped 1.5 percentage points in a single day, now holding 8.2% of tokens across its models. Three new entrants—including Anthropic's Claude 4.6 Sonnet and OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna Pro—cracked the top 50, while Mistral AI, an older NVIDIA model, and xAI's Grok dropped out. DeepSeek and stealth remain the duopoly, commanding 40.6% combined.
highlights: Zhipu AI's daily jump: +1.5 percentage points to 8.2% share
